crates/deadsync-song-lua/Cargo.toml.text:
[package]
name = "deadsync-song-lua"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
license = "GPL-3.0"

[features]
test-support = []
performance = []
rust-engine = ["dep:deadlib-lua"]

[dependencies]
deadlib-lua = { path = "../deadlib-lua", optional = true, default-features = false }
deadlib-audio-decode = { path = "../deadlib-audio-decode" }
deadlib-render-core = { path = "../deadlib-render-core" }
deadsync-chart = { path = "../deadsync-chart" }
deadsync-core = { path = "../deadsync-core" }
deadsync-gameplay = { path = "../deadsync-gameplay" }
deadsync-notefield = { path = "../deadsync-notefield" }
deadsync-noteskin = { path = "../deadsync-noteskin" }
glam = "0.34.1"
twox-hash = "2.1.5"
deadlib-assets = { path = "../deadlib-assets" }
deadlib-present = { path = "../deadlib-present" }
deadlib-video = { path = "../deadlib-video" }
deadsync-rules = { path = "../deadsync-rules" }
chrono = "0.4.45"
image = "0.25.10"
itoa = "1.0.18"
log = "0.4.34"
memchr = "2.8.3"
mlua = { workspace = true, features = ["lua51", "vendored", "send"] }
rustc-hash = "2.1.3"
serde_json = { version = "1.0.151", features = ["float_roundtrip"] }
smallvec = "1.16.4"

[lints.clippy]
perf = { level = "warn", priority = -1 }

inline_always = "allow"

[dev-dependencies]
zstd = "0.14.3"
tempfile = "3.27.0"
deadsync-assets = { path = "../deadsync-assets" }
deadsync-config = { path = "../deadsync-config" }
deadsync-profile = { path = "../deadsync-profile" }
deadsync-profile-gameplay = { path = "../deadsync-profile-gameplay" }
deadsync-simfile = { path = "../deadsync-simfile" }
deadlib-render-core = { path = "../deadlib-render-core", features = ["test-util"] }
deadlib-render = { path = "../deadlib-render" }
winit = "0.30.13"
